purpose: Offline, provider-free, DB-free diagnostic classification of the frozen M10R primary failures.

evidence_grades.E1_DIRECT_PROVENANCE: Frozen runtime provenance directly identifies the wrong semantic decision or execution boundary.
evidence_grades.E2_STRUCTURAL_CORROBORATION: Frozen provenance plus deterministic candidate/reference structure supports a semantically relevant mechanism.
evidence_grades.E3_STRONG_ASSOCIATION: Strong categorical or statistical association without case-level causal or transfer proof.
evidence_grades.E4_MANUAL_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: Human/static interpretation after automated classification; never eligible for dominance.
evidence_grades.E5_UNCLASSIFIED: Required evidence is absent or insufficient.

primary_mechanisms.definition: Frozen M1 rejected a forbidden function.
Frozen M1 rejected an unknown column.
Frozen M1 rejected an unknown table.
Frozen M1/EXPLAIN transport rejected candidate placeholder-like syntax.
Expected governed metric is known and frozen grounding selected a semantically different metric.
Metric identity is correct but frozen governed semantic slots differ from the benchmark-owned slots.
Frozen grounding matches expected semantics but deterministic compiled SQL represents different semantics.
Expected governed semantic failure without enough frozen grounding/compiler evidence for a stronger cause.
A frozen expected-direct case was sent to the governed semantic path without a benchmark-supported governed contract.
exclusions: route mismatch alone without scope evidence

primary_mechanisms.definition: A semantically incompatible retrieved example crossed the frozen memory-use threshold.
Candidate contains a semantically wrong motif present in the retrieved verified example and absent from the reference.
Executed direct candidate uses a wrong table, semantic source column, required relation, or projected/filter leaf.
Executed direct candidate has a semantically relevant predicate or value-condition difference.
Executed direct candidate has a semantically relevant join or relational-composition difference.
Executed direct candidate has a semantically relevant aggregate or grouping difference.
Executed direct candidate has a semantically relevant formula, operand, scale, or metric-expression difference.
Executed direct candidate has a semantically relevant temporal column, boundary, period, function, or granularity difference.
Executed direct candidate has a semantically relevant window function, partition, order, frame, rank, or offset difference.
Executed direct candidate has a semantically relevant ordering, direction, limit, offset, or top-N difference.
Executed direct candidate has a semantically relevant projection or result-shape mismatch not recovered by the shadow contract evaluator.
Executed direct candidate has a semantically relevant DISTINCT or set-operation difference.
Multiple independent semantic axes differ and no single mechanism clearly dominates.
Frozen evidence does not support a trustworthy mechanism assignment.

memory_transfer_levels.M0_NO_TRANSFER_EVIDENCE: No frozen retrieved-example identity or SQL evidence is available.
memory_transfer_levels.M2_STRUCTURAL_SIMILARITY: Deterministic structure is similar but no wrong motif transfer is shown.
memory_transfer_levels.M3_WRONG_MOTIF_CARRYOVER: Candidate and memory share a semantically wrong motif absent from reference.
memory_transfer_levels.M4_NEAR_EXACT_WRONG_SQL_CARRYOVER: Candidate near-exactly carries a semantically wrong memory SQL.
